# case: caa-account
## problems
## notes
fix.n.caa-tree {"name":"example.org"}
## check
z=example.org&r=is+@+CAA+0+issue+%22letsencrypt.org;+accounturi=https://acme-v02.api.letsencrypt.org/acme/acct/123456%22
## bind
; DNS change request for example.org (DomainScope)
; The records below are what the changed sets hold afterwards;
; every other record of the zone stays as it is.
$ORIGIN example.org.

; example.org CAA
; replaces every CAA record of @
@ 3600 IN CAA 0 issue "letsencrypt.org; accounturi=https://acme-v02.api.letsencrypt.org/acme/acct/123456"
## route53
{
  "Comment": "DNS change request for example.org (DomainScope)",
  "Changes": [
    {
      "Action": "UPSERT",
      "ResourceRecordSet": {
        "Name": "example.org.",
        "Type": "CAA",
        "TTL": 3600,
        "ResourceRecords": [
          {
            "Value": "0 issue \"letsencrypt.org; accounturi=https://acme-v02.api.letsencrypt.org/acme/acct/123456\""
          }
        ]
      }
    }
  ]
}
## cloudflare
#!/bin/sh
# DNS change request for example.org (DomainScope)
# Needs an API token that may edit this zone's DNS records (Zone > DNS > Edit) and the zone ID
# (the zone's Overview page). Neither is written here: set both in your shell first.
: "${CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN:?set CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN to your API token}"
: "${CLOUDFLARE_ZONE_ID:?set CLOUDFLARE_ZONE_ID to the zone ID of example.org}"
API="https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/zones/$CLOUDFLARE_ZONE_ID/dns_records"

# 1. Delete the example.org CAA records there now (they were not read)
#    Find their ids (none: skip this step), then:
curl -sS "$API?type=CAA&name=example.org" -H "Authorization: Bearer $CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN"
curl -sS -X DELETE "$API/RECORD_ID" -H "Authorization: Bearer $CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN"

# 2. Add example.org CAA 0 issue "letsencrypt.org; accounturi=https://acme-v02.api.letsencrypt.org/acme/acct/123456"
curl -sS -X POST "$API" -H "Authorization: Bearer $CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  --data '{"type":"CAA","name":"example.org","data":{"flags":0,"tag":"issue","value":"letsencrypt.org; accounturi=https://acme-v02.api.letsencrypt.org/acme/acct/123456"},"ttl":3600}'
## cloudflare notes
fix.fn.cloudflare-ids {}
## octodns
# DNS change request for example.org (DomainScope)
# In the zone's YAML (example.org.yaml): set these entries; the other names stay as they are.
---
'':
  - ttl: 3600
    type: CAA
    values:
      - flags: 0
        tag: issue
        value: 'letsencrypt.org; accounturi=https://acme-v02.api.letsencrypt.org/acme/acct/123456'
## terraform-cloudflare
# DNS change request for example.org (DomainScope)
# terraform-provider-cloudflare v4 (cloudflare_record; v5 names it cloudflare_dns_record).
variable "cloudflare_zone_id" {
  type        = string
  description = "The zone ID of example.org"
}

# remove the resources of any other example.org CAA record (the current ones were not read)

resource "cloudflare_record" "caa_apex" {
  zone_id  = var.cloudflare_zone_id
  name     = "example.org"
  type     = "CAA"
  data {
    flags = 0
    tag   = "issue"
    value = "letsencrypt.org; accounturi=https://acme-v02.api.letsencrypt.org/acme/acct/123456"
  }
  ttl      = 3600
}
## terraform-route53
# DNS change request for example.org (DomainScope)
# aws_route53_record manages a whole record set: every value of the name and type is listed.
variable "route53_zone_id" {
  type        = string
  description = "The hosted zone ID of example.org"
}

resource "aws_route53_record" "caa_apex" {
  zone_id = var.route53_zone_id
  name    = "example.org"
  type    = "CAA"
  ttl     = 3600
  records = ["0 issue \"letsencrypt.org; accounturi=https://acme-v02.api.letsencrypt.org/acme/acct/123456\""]
}
## en
DNS change request: example.org

Please make the following changes in the DNS zone example.org. Records not listed here stay as they are.

1. Replace: CAA records
   Name: example.org
   Value:
     0 issue "letsencrypt.org; accounturi=https://acme-v02.api.letsencrypt.org/acme/acct/123456"
   TTL: 3600
   Replace every CAA record of the name with the values above.

Notes:
- CAA at example.org applies to every name below it that has no CAA record of its own.

Once the change is made, this link shows whether public DNS resolvers see it:
https://example.github.io/domainscope/#/change/check?z=example.org&r=is+@+CAA+0+issue+%22letsencrypt.org;+accounturi=https://acme-v02.api.letsencrypt.org/acme/acct/123456%22
## tr
DNS değişiklik talebi: example.org

Lütfen example.org DNS zone’unda aşağıdaki değişiklikleri yapın. Burada yer almayan kayıtlar olduğu gibi kalır.

1. Değiştir: CAA kayıtları
   Ad: example.org
   Değer:
     0 issue "letsencrypt.org; accounturi=https://acme-v02.api.letsencrypt.org/acme/acct/123456"
   TTL: 3600
   Adın tüm CAA kayıtlarını yukarıdaki değerlerle değiştirin.

Notlar:
- example.org adındaki CAA, kendi CAA kaydı olmayan altındaki her ada da uygulanır.

Değişiklik yapıldıktan sonra genel DNS çözümleyicilerinin onu görüp görmediğini bu bağlantı gösterir:
https://example.github.io/domainscope/#/change/check?z=example.org&r=is+@+CAA+0+issue+%22letsencrypt.org;+accounturi=https://acme-v02.api.letsencrypt.org/acme/acct/123456%22
